candidate.title: MES 15-min ORB failure fade
candidate.one_line: Fade a failed 15-min opening-range breakout: enter when price closes back inside the 09:30-09:45 range after a break; ATR stop; flat 15:55. Source: ORB false-break / liquidity-grab fade (Steady Turtle ES/NQ ORB notes; common futures tape).

sources.title: Opening Range Breakout Strategy for ES & NQ Futures — failed-break fade notes
sources.creator: Steady Turtle
sources.claim: Fade only a confirmed failed break: a bar closes outside the 15-min opening range, then closes back inside; enter opposite the break on the next bar with stop beyond the failed extreme.

hypothesis.behavior: Failed MES opening-range breaks are stop-runs that reverse once price reclaims the range; fading the reclaim captures forced-exit liquidity.
failure_theory: True breakout days keep pushing after a brief reclaim (whipsaw).
MES ORB continuation already survives QF screens; the fade may be the losing side of the same coin.
Costs and next-bar fills on 5m bars may erase a thin false-break edge.

setup: MES RTH 09:30-16:00 ET on 5m bars; opening range is 09:30-09:45 high/low; signals on completed bars, fill next open.
long_entry: After 09:50, close crosses back above the opening-range low (failed downside break) while still below the range high.
short_entry: After 09:50, close crosses back below the opening-range high (failed upside break) while still above the range low.

exits.rule: ATR stop; optional time exit after N bars; flat 15:55.
exits.time_exit: Flat by 15:55 ET; no overnight position.

stop_atr.rationale: Stop distance in ATR(14) multiples beyond the failed extreme region.

hold_bars.rationale: Max hold in 5m bars (30/60/90 minutes); source fades resolve inside the morning.

candidate_specific_checks: Evaluate only the predeclared grid; no expansion after seeing results.

exclusions: No paper/live trading or automatic promotion.

prior_work.closest_tried: MES/SPY/QQQ 15-min ORB continuation survivors in QF (e.g. qfc_27bdd8f5 family); queue dummies were SPY inside-bar/ORB continuation
prior_work.claimed_difference: Opposite side of ORB: fade a reclaim after a failed break instead of riding the breakout.
